body.purpose: Content: running text, table data, form values.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover, filled button hover.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Primary action, Google Blue, fully rounded.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { background: #1a73e8; color: #ffffff; padding: 9px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; font-family: 'Google Sans', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-btn-filled:hover { background: #1765cc; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(60,64,67,0.30), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(60,64,67,0.15); }

components.name: Outlined Text Field
components.description: Floating-label outlined field, the Gmail/Drive pattern.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #bdc1c6; border-radius: 4px; padding: 15px 13px 7px; color: #202124; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid #1a73e8; padding: 14px 12px 6px; } .ds-label { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: -8px; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 4px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5f6368; }

components.name: Nav Rail Item (active)
components.description: Signature component: icon + label with a selection pill, Google's own pattern.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #5f6368; font-family: 'Google Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-pill { width: 52px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-rail-item--active .ds-rail-pill { background: #e8f0fe; color: #1a73e8; } .ds-rail-label { font-size: 0.67rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-rail-item--active .ds-rail-label { color: #1a73e8; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Status chip, flat tint fill, fully rounded.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e8e3e; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Bordered, flat, white — shadow only on hover if interactive.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(60,64,67,0.30), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(60,64,67,0.15); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Google Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #202124; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.83rem; color: #5f6368; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: After three discarded directions (warm-terracotta product system, school-registry/ledger concept, colorful modern-SaaS), the confirmed direction is a literal Google Workspace replica: same blue, same neutral grays, same Google Sans + Roboto pairing, same component shapes. Staff, teachers, and students already know how Gmail/Drive/Classroom work — familiarity beats originality for a daily-use internal tool. Background is #ffffff everywhere, with zero exceptions; this was the single most-corrected point across every iteration.
keyCharacteristics: Background is #ffffff everywhere, no exceptions — not even a 2% gray tint on hover or table headers.
Google's own palette: Blue #1a73e8 for every primary action, Red/Yellow/Green reserved for status only.
Google Sans for headings and UI chrome, Roboto for body/data.
Fully-rounded buttons and chips, outlined inputs with a floating label, nav rail with icon + label + selection pill.
No custom brand color — the identity is behavioral familiarity, not visual distinctiveness.

rules.name: The Pure White Rule
rules.body: Every background in this system is #ffffff. No gray fill anywhere. Use Blue Tint (#e8f0fe) or a border for hover/selected feedback instead.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only brand/action color. Red, yellow, and green exist solely to report state, never decoratively.

rules.name: The Chrome/Content Split Rule
rules.body: Google Sans is reserved for UI chrome (titles, nav, buttons). Roboto handles everything that is data or content.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: At rest, every container is separated by a 1px border, not a shadow. Shadow only on hover or for floating elements.

dos: Do keep every background #ffffff, including table headers, hover states, and skeleton loaders.
Do use Google Blue (#1a73e8) as the only brand/action color.
Do use Google Sans for chrome and Roboto for content, never swapped.
Do use the nav-rail selection pill pattern for active navigation state.
Do use shadcn-vue primitives restyled to match these exact Material specs.
donts: Don't introduce any custom brand hue outside Google's blue/red/yellow/green.
Don't use a tinted/warm/cream/beige background anywhere, even subtly.
Don't use gradient fills, colored icon chips, or a gradient hero-metric stat tile.
Don't box stats inside generic SaaS card grids with icon badges.
Don't replicate Google's logo/wordmark — only the color system, typography, and component shapes.
